mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the predicted negative returns are not statistically distinguishable from zero at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a housing starts contraction (HOUST < previous 12-month average) signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST < 12-month moving average
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mean return is not significantly below zero at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly different from zero during triggered periods at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and increases recession risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month moving average for four consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the predicted negative effect is not statistically significant at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the federal funds rate and consumer price index above their respective 12-month moving averages signals a dual tightening in monetary and inflationary pressures, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 12-month moving average AND CPIAUCSL > 12-month moving average
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during co-tightening episodes at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in real personal savings (proxied by RSAFS YoY growth > 5%) alongside a decline in personal consumption expenditures growth (GDPC1 YoY < 1%) signals a shift from spending to saving, which reduces aggregate demand and corporate revenue growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth > 5% AND GDPC1 YoY growth < 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the predicted negative effect is not statistically significant at 90% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.5% month-over-month for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which raises wage pressures and input costs, ultimately leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations rise.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered periods at 95% confidence.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months signals a recovery in residential investment, which boosts construction-related industries and overall economic activity, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 12-month moving average for five consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during triggered housing recoveries at 90% confidence.
